name: sts2.fun statistics
author: sts2.fun
description: Uploads your finished runs to https://sts2.fun so they count in the community stats, and shows your sts2.fun account on the main menu. With each run it also sends what the .run file leaves out: full shop stock with prices and purchases, every event option shown, and potions gained, used and discarded; plus which mods were loaded, so runs with gameplay mods are left out of the stats. Keeps your normal save profile when only non-gameplay mods are loaded. Turn uploads off by setting "Enabled": false in sts2fun_stats/config.json. Does not affect gameplay.
